from hep_lfx import HepComponent, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class ResolutionGate(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value',required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name='ready',method='route_ready',group_outputs=True),Output(name='blocked',method='route_blocked',group_outputs=True)]
 def select(self)->Data:
  selected=payload(self.value)['branch']
  if selected not in ('ready','blocked'):raise ValueError('未知解析分支')
  excluded=[name for name in ('ready','blocked') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
 async def route_ready(self)->Data:return self.select()
 async def route_blocked(self)->Data:return self.select()
